Frequently Asked Questions

Our Powdersville house is under builder warranty. Can you still service the HVAC?

Yes, and independent service protects rather than threatens coverage. Manufacturer equipment warranties require documented maintenance regardless of who built the house, and a verification visit creates the service record plus baseline readings. Builder workmanship warranties are separate and stay with the builder.

Does a tightly built new home really need extra ventilation or air treatment?

It carries more of the burden indoors, yes. Tight envelopes cut energy waste but slow the exit of cooking byproducts, moisture, and off-gassing from new materials. Treatment and filtration matched to the system handle inside what the envelope no longer lets drift out.

What runs first, the EV charger or the panel upgrade?

The evaluation. An electrician totals existing load and measures remaining capacity; if the charger fits, it goes in on a properly sized circuit, and if not, the panel work gets quoted first. Installing the charger before checking is how nuisance trips and overheated conductors happen.

How often does a dryer vent actually need cleaning?

Annually for most households, sooner with long vent runs or heavy laundry loads. Warning signs include clothes taking multiple cycles, a hot dryer top, and lint around the outside vent flap. The risk is real: lint accumulation is a leading cause of dryer fires, and clearing it is a short visit.

Which communities around Powdersville do you cover?

Easley, Piedmont, and Liberty share the same routes, and the chat team can confirm any corridor address quickly.
